Legacy command intent:

ViewBS MethOneRegion --sample data/test_data/test_WT.tab.gz,WT --region chr2:1006-1010 --outdir out --prefix one --context CG --minDepth 1 --maxDepth 100 --flank 0

Expected output provenance:

The local legacy Perl entrypoint cannot be executed in this environment because Getopt::Long::Subcommand is not installed. This fixture uses the checked-in indexed methylation fixture data/test_data/test_WT.tab.gz and follows the checked-in legacy implementation in lib/Meth/OneRegion.pm:

- query chr2:1006-1010;
- keep CG records with 1 <= methylated + unmethylated <= 100;
- write per-site methylation levels as C_num / (C_num + T_num).
